diagnosticOverlay: Only selected-object-identity entries create copies. Original source hash, exact original line text, helper insertion and final overlay hash are checked. No change to Object.is truth, evaluated arguments, assertions outside selected sites, production code, or deadlines.
scope: Full canonical original-mode files may count toward inventory at their exact source after complete proof. Diagnostic copies never grant canonical coverage. Original failures, resource stops, and earlier source identities remain retained; no assertions or deadlines are changed.
